title: Supersymmetry installed material-fluid runtime config V1
description: Explicit local installed-tool and seed locations for the concrete client and dedicated-server runtime-pair owner. Every path is an absolute local file URI; relative path interpretation is forbidden.

launcher_executable_uri.description: Local URI of the installed PrismLauncher or MultiMC executable.

launcher_root_uri.description: Local URI of the selected launcher's data root containing instances/.

launcher_profile.description: Optional launcher account/profile name; null leaves selection to the installed launcher.

launcher_java_uri.description: Optional local URI of an admitted launcher-host Java candidate.

launcher_java_state_uri.description: Optional local URI of the managed launcher-host Java state root.

seed_root_uris.description: Ordered local roots used only to seed hash-matching Packwiz artifacts; the staged pack remains authority.

attach_timeout_seconds.description: Bound for attaching the launched client process.

seed_receipt_uri.description: Local URI of one identity-valid retained SUSY server materialization V2 receipt, used only as Cleanroom/bootstrap and hash-matched artifact seed authority.

java_uri.description: Local URI of the Java executable used for Packwiz Installer and the dedicated server.

packwiz_installer_jar_uri.description: Local URI of the Packwiz Installer bootstrap JAR.

shutdown_timeout_seconds.description: Bound after the explicit Minecraft stop command for all save acknowledgements and exit.
